title: Novel App knock-in mouse model shows key features of amyloid pathology and reveals profound metabolic dysregulation of microglia

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This primary mouse-model study analyzes Alzheimer’s pathology. Age is used to describe disease-model progression, without an explicit analysis or interpretation of an aging process.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Engineered App SAA knock-in genotype carrying Swedish, Arctic, and Austrian mutations
causal_design_reviewer.outcome: Amyloid pathology, microglial lipid/metabolic and transcriptomic alterations, neurodegeneration markers, brain metabolism, and behavioral phenotypes
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Outcomes in heterozygous and homozygous App SAA mice compared with wild-type littermate controls
